neighbours.label: The negation or exception in a multiple-choice question stem: 'Which ... is not ...', 'all of the following except'; the same negation in plain statements stays quiet
fire:
Which of these animals is not a reptile?
(a) snake
(b) lizard
(c) frog
Which planet does not have any moons?
Which of the following does NOT describe a cell wall?
All of the following cause inflation except which one?
Which one of these countries is not in Africa?
Question 4: Which statement is not true of the French Revolution?
Which tool would not be useful for measuring length?

All of these are prime numbers except:
A. 3
B. 5
C. 9
quiet: These animals are not reptiles, as the guide explained to us.
This planet does not have any moons, as far as anyone knows.
The cell wall does not describe a full barrier to water.
Many things cause inflation, and one of them is war.
One of these countries is in Africa, and the other is in Asia.
The French Revolution was not a single event but a long process.
This tool would not be useful for measuring length.

These are prime numbers:
A. 3
B. 5
C. 7

notes: Card: ' not' x6, ' following' x2, ' would' x2, in exam-style text; the - pole also fires on '(b)', '(c)' answer labels. Probe: 'Which of the following is not' 1.93, 'following are true except' 2.07, 'Which simple machine does not' 1.22; 'The dog does not' 0.06, 'does NOT include' 0.15, 'Which would you rather' 0.05, embedded 'which of them had not yet' 0.52. Very sparse pole, so readings can exceed 1.
